limitations: fixed eight-entity public interface; no entity-count transfer claim

all seed intervals exploratory; adaptive synthetic study

title: Trained retention interventions, causal prediction and physical cost
question: Does removing multiplicative decay improve causal forecasts and physical decisions under matched training?
hypothesis: Retention removal may improve usable historical memory, conditional on erase, public entity isolation and shared key controls.
